title: PairQR
description: QR payload shown by the host and scanned by the joiner. Missing v defaults to 1; v > 1 must be rejected with ErrUnsupportedProtocol. Unknown fields are ignored.

v.description: QR format version. Optional on the wire; absent means 1.

host.description: LAN address of the host's ping server.

fingerprint.description: Hex SHA-256 of the host TLS certificate (TOFU pin).

pubkey.description: Base64 ed25519 device identity public key.

code.description: Optional human-typable 6-digit pairing code derived from token (anti-mistake UX + consent, NOT a security boundary). Readers that do not know it must ignore it.

candidates.description: Optional comma-separated list of candidate host LAN IPs discovered on the host.
